items.title: 川普揚言若談判未果 可能「殲滅」伊朗
items.title_en: Trump Warns He May ‘Annihilate’ Iran If Talks Fail
paras: 美國總統川普週二 (22 日) 在聯合國大會發表演說，警告若無法與伊朗達成終戰協議，他可能迅速「殲滅伊朗」。不過，他同時預測，美伊可望在 11 月 3 日期中選舉後達成和平協議。
川普表示，他正面臨一項重大決定：究竟是與伊朗達成協議，讓該國重建並變得更加強大，還是迅速摧毀伊朗政權，使其無法再傷害其他國家與人民。
他呼籲各國配合美國，在經濟上孤立伊朗，迫使德黑蘭重返談判桌。
對於期中選舉可能影響美國對伊朗政策的說法，川普回應，伊朗領導階層正在觀望選舉結果，卻忽略他本人不需再次競選，而且任期仍有兩年半。
部分分析人士認為，若民主黨在期中選舉後掌控國會，川普處理伊朗戰事的籌碼可能受到削弱。
川普演說後告訴記者，美國官員當天與伊朗代表團進行約三小時且「非常順利」的會談。
不過，他隨後澄清，特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與庫許納 (Jared Kushner) 接觸的是伊朗的調解人，並非伊朗官員本人，並形容這場會談「富有成效」。
川普在長達 37 分鐘的演說中，將伊朗戰事置於其外交政策主軸，聲稱美國參戰已阻止德黑蘭取得核武。他也主張，美國必須維持在西半球的主導地位，避免安全威脅在當地立足。
談及美軍突襲委內瑞拉並逮捕該國領導人的行動，川普表示，這證明美國不會再容許威脅在西半球擴張。他宣稱：「其他人只談和平，我則締造了和平。」
川普也將矛頭指向墨西哥與古巴。他稱墨西哥是「販毒集團暴力的中心」，要求墨西哥政府重新掌控國土；談到古巴時則表示，美國正推動當地局勢出現「根本性改變」。
古巴代表團成員在川普提及美國對古巴的施壓行動時離開會場。川普形容古巴是「徹底失敗的國家」，並預測其政權最終將垮台。
在國際組織方面，川普再度批評聯合國官僚體系，但沒有提出新的攻擊，也未暗示美國將退出更多聯合國機構。他另點名國際刑事法院，強調不會允許美軍人員或其他美國公民接受他所稱「反美法庭」的調查或審判。
川普發表演說前不到一週，聯合國事實調查團表示，有合理理由相信美軍對伊朗的兩次空襲可能構成戰爭罪，其中一次攻擊擊中伊朗南部米納卜市一所小學。
談及人工智慧 (AI)，川普承認這項技術帶來挑戰，但強調不會壓抑一項規模可能超越工業革命的技術。
聯合國安全理事會預定週三討論 AI 與國際安全議題。
演說後，川普展開密集外交行程，先後會見英國、烏克蘭及日本領袖。
英國首相柏南 (Andy Burnham) 表示，兩人首次會談討論貿易、烏克蘭及福克蘭群島地位；日本首相高市早苗則稱，這場會談將在亞洲安全環境嚴峻之際，展現美日同盟的力量。
川普另與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基討論結束俄烏戰爭的方法，並預計本週稍晚在華府與中國國家主席習近平會晤。
外媒報導，伊朗已向美國提議重開荷姆茲海峽美軍解封「7天內」就重開，美伊局勢有趨緩跡象，布蘭特原油期貨週二下滑 1.09%，收每桶 99.25 美元；西德州原油期貨下跌 1.24%，收每桶 94.59 美元，連續第五個交易日收黑。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a speech at the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday (the 22nd), warning that if a final peace deal with Iran cannot be reached, he could swiftly “annihilate Iran.” He also predicted that the United States and Iran could reach a peace agreement after the November 3 mid‑term elections.

Trump said he faces a major decision: whether to strike a deal that would allow Iran to rebuild and become stronger, or to quickly destroy the Iranian regime so it can no longer harm other countries and peoples.
He called on other nations to cooperate with the United States in economically isolating Iran and forcing Tehran back to the negotiating table.

When asked whether the mid‑term elections might affect U.S. policy toward Iran, Trump replied that Iran’s leadership is watching the election results, but ignored the fact that he himself does not need to run again and still has two and a half years left in his term.
Some analysts believe that if Democrats control Congress after the mid‑terms, Trump’s leverage in dealing with the Iran conflict could be weakened.
After his speech, Trump told reporters that U.S. officials had a roughly three‑hour, “very smooth” meeting with an Iranian delegation that day.
He later clarified that envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were in contact with Iran’s mediators, not Iranian officials themselves, and described the talks as “productive.”

In his 37‑minute address, Trump placed the Iran war at the center of his foreign‑policy agenda, claiming U.S. involvement has prevented Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons and asserting that America must maintain dominance in the Western Hemisphere to keep security threats from taking root there.

Discussing a U.S. raid in Venezuela that captured the country’s leader, Trump said it showed America will no longer allow threats to expand in the Western Hemisphere. He declared, “Others only talk about peace; I create peace.”

Trump also pointed the finger at Mexico and Cuba. He called Mexico the “center of drug‑cartel violence,” demanding the Mexican government retake control of its territory; regarding Cuba he said the United States is pushing for a “fundamental change” in the island’s situation.
When Trump mentioned U.S. pressure on Cuba, members of the Cuban delegation left the hall. Trump described Cuba as a “totally failed state” and predicted its regime would eventually collapse.

Regarding international organizations, Trump again criticized United Nations bureaucracy but offered no new attacks and did not hint that the U.S. would withdraw from additional UN bodies. He singled out the International Criminal Court, emphasizing that U.S. personnel or other Americans will not be subject to what he called a “anti‑American court.”

Less than a week before his speech, a UN fact‑finding mission said there is reasonable cause to believe two U.S. airstrikes on Iran could constitute war crimes, one of which hit an elementary school in the southern city of Minab.
On the topic of artificial intelligence (AI), Trump acknowledged the technology poses challenges but stressed he would not suppress a technology whose scale could surpass the Industrial Revolution.
The UN Security Council is scheduled to discuss AI and international security on Wednesday.
After the speech, Trump embarked on an intensive diplomatic tour, meeting consecutively with leaders from the United Kingdom, Ukraine and Japan.

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the first meeting between the two leaders covered trade, Ukraine and the status of the Falkland Islands; Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said the talks would demonstrate the strength of the U.S.–Japan alliance amid a severe Asian security environment.
Trump also discussed ways to end the Russia‑Ukraine war with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and is expected to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping later this week in Washington.

Foreign media reported that Iran has offered the United States to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days of a U.S. lift of restrictions, indicating a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran relations; Brent crude futures fell 1.09% on Tuesday to $99.25 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate dropped 1.24% to $94.59, marking the fifth consecutive day of declines.

items.title: 皇家加勒比跨足陸上度假市場 傳砸30億美元取得Sandals半數股權
items.title_en: Royal Caribbean Moves into Land-Based Resorts, Said to Spend $3 Billion for Half of Sandals
paras: 皇家加勒比集團(RCL-US)正接近與加勒比海度假村業者 Sandals Resorts International 達成一項約30億美元的交易，計畫取得後者50%股權。若交易完成，Sandals整體估值將達約60億美元，也將讓皇家加勒比進一步從郵輪業務跨足陸上全包式度假市場。
知情人士透露，雙方目前仍在進行交易協商，皇家加勒比擬取得Sandals 50%股權，部分Stewart家族成員則可能繼續持有剩餘股權。按照目前討論中的架構，皇家加勒比將成為Sandals的控股股東，未來甚至不排除進一步取得Sandals全部股權。
不過，交易目前尚未完成，相關協商仍可能出現變化。知情人士指出，雙方最快可能在未來幾天內達成協議，但也不能排除談判最終破局的可能，因此30億美元交易規模、50%持股比例及約60億美元估值，目前都仍屬協商中的條件。
若交易落實，這將成為皇家加勒比歷來規模最大的收購交易之一，並進一步改變公司的業務版圖。皇家加勒比近年積極擴大郵輪以外的度假產品，除了經營郵輪航線，也持續發展私人目的地及陸上度假項目，而取得Sandals股權將使公司直接切入加勒比海全包式度假村市場。
Sandals及旗下Beaches品牌在加勒比海擁有超過十座度假村，相關業務涵蓋牙買加、巴哈馬、聖露西亞、格瑞那達、安提瓜、巴貝多及土克斯及開科斯群島等市場。另有報導指出，Sandals及Beaches合計約有20座度假村，若皇家加勒比取得控制權，將能進一步擴大其在加勒比海陸上旅遊市場的布局。
對皇家加勒比而言，Sandals的全包式度假模式與現有郵輪業務具有不同的產品型態。公司可以藉由郵輪與度假村之間的交叉銷售，讓旅客在郵輪假期之外增加陸上住宿選項，同時也有機會把Sandals既有客群導向皇家加勒比的郵輪產品。
皇家加勒比近年已明確將業務方向從單純郵輪業者擴展至更廣泛的度假平台。公司2026年第二季財報顯示，集團旗下全球品牌及合作品牌合計營運71艘船，航線涵蓋全球120多個國家的逾1,000個目的地。公司同時持續投資陸上目的地，2026年全年資本支出預估約47億美元，其中包括新船訂單及陸上目的地相關投資。
皇家加勒比此前也表示，正在建立更廣泛的度假平台，希望讓旅客在更多不同場合選擇旗下產品。公司2026年第二季業績中指出，消費者對度假體驗的需求仍然強勁，2027年的預訂趨勢亦較歷史水準領先。
Sandals方面，品牌近年也持續進行大規模擴張及升級。2026年公司曾公布，Beaches品牌未來5至6年將新增5座度假村，並投入接近10億美元進行開發及既有度假村升級，包括牙買加、巴貝多、巴哈馬及聖文森等市場。此外，Sandals Montego Bay及Sandals Royal Caribbean等既有度假村也規劃進行大規模改造。
此次交易消息傳出後，皇家加勒比股價一度下跌約6%, 市場對這筆大型交易的反應受到關注。皇家加勒比股價過去一年亦累計下跌約25%, 公司近期曾調整營收成長預期，歐洲郵輪需求變化成為市場關注因素之一。
不過，皇家加勒比近期基本營運表現仍維持一定動能。公司2026年第二季淨利約11億美元，較2025年同期約12億美元略降；2026年前6個月淨利約21億美元，高於去年同期約19億美元。第二季營收較去年同期增加2.94億美元，前6個月營收則增加7.47億美元。
公司預期2026年第三季營收將年增約8%, 淨收益率預計大致持平，並預估第三季調整後每股盈餘介於6.26至6.36美元。截至2026年6月底，皇家加勒比仍有8.05億美元股票回購授權額度。
對Sandals而言，這筆交易則可能為家族持有企業引入大型上市旅遊集團作為控股股東。Sandals創辦人Gordon「Butch」Stewart於2021年去世後，家族資產及信託安排曾涉及爭議及法律程序，而公司股權未來如何安排，也將成為交易談判的重要環節。
目前雙方均未正式宣布交易協議，因此仍無法確認最終成交價格、持股比例、融資方式及治理架構。若談判順利完成，皇家加勒比將從郵輪市場進一步延伸至加勒比海全包式度假村市場；若協議未能達成，則上述交易條件也可能完全不會落實。
paras_en: Royal Caribbean Group (RCL-US) is close to striking a roughly $3 billion deal with Caribbean resort operator Sandals Resorts International to acquire a 50% stake. If completed, Sandals would be valued at about $6 billion, allowing Royal Caribbean to expand from cruise ships into the all‑inclusive land‑based resort market.

Sources say negotiations are ongoing, with Royal Caribbean aiming for a 50% stake while some members of the Stewart family may retain the remaining equity. Under the current structure, Royal Caribbean would become Sandals’ controlling shareholder and could later seek full ownership.

The transaction is not yet finalized and terms could change. Insiders note an agreement could be reached within days, but a breakdown remains possible, so the $3 billion price, 50% stake and $6 billion valuation are still subject to negotiation.

If the deal closes, it would be one of the largest acquisitions in Royal Caribbean’s history and would reshape its business footprint. The cruise line has been expanding beyond ships, developing private destinations and land‑based projects, and a Sandals stake would give it direct access to the Caribbean all‑inclusive resort market.

Sandals and its Beaches brand operate more than ten resorts across the Caribbean, including Jamaica, the Bahamas, St. Lucia, Grenada, Antigua, Barbados and the Turks‑and‑Caicos Islands. Reports say the two brands together run about 20 resorts, and a Royal Caribbean‑controlled Sandals would broaden its land‑based presence in the region.

For Royal Caribbean, Sandals’ all‑inclusive model complements its cruise business. Cross‑selling between ships and resorts could offer travelers land‑based accommodations after a cruise and funnel Sandals’ existing guests toward Royal Caribbean’s cruise products.

Royal Caribbean has recently shifted from a pure cruise operator to a broader vacation platform. Its Q2 2026 earnings report shows the group operates 71 vessels under its own and partner brands, serving over 1,000 destinations in more than 120 countries, and it plans roughly $4.7 billion in capital expenditures for 2026, covering new ships and land‑based investments.

The company has said it is building a wider vacation platform so travelers can choose its products in more settings. Its Q2 2026 results note strong consumer demand for vacation experiences and booking trends for 2027 that are ahead of historical levels.

Sandals has been expanding and upgrading its portfolio. In 2026 the company announced that the Beaches brand will add five resorts over the next five to six years, investing nearly $1 billion in new builds and upgrades in markets such as Jamaica, Barbados, the Bahamas and St. Vincent, while existing properties like Sandals Montego Bay and Sandals Royal Caribbean are slated for major renovations.

After the deal rumor surfaced, Royal Caribbean’s share price fell about 6%, drawing market attention to the potential transaction. Over the past year the stock has dropped roughly 25%, and the company recently revised its revenue growth outlook amid shifting European cruise demand.

Nevertheless, recent operating performance remains solid. Royal Caribbean posted Q2 2026 net income of about $1.1 billion, slightly down from roughly $1.2 billion a year earlier; six‑month net income was about $2.1 billion, up from $1.9 billion year‑over‑year. Q2 revenue rose $294 million versus the prior year, and six‑month revenue increased by $747 million.

The firm expects Q3 2026 revenue to grow about 8% year‑over‑year, with net margin roughly flat, and forecasts adjusted earnings per share between $6.26 and $6.36. As of June 30 2026, Royal Caribbean still has $805 million of authorized stock‑repurchase capacity.

For Sandals, the deal could bring a large publicly‑listed travel group in as a controlling shareholder of the family‑owned business. Founder Gordon “Butch” Stewart died in 2021, and the family’s asset and trust arrangements have been contested in legal proceedings, making the future equity structure a key negotiation point.

No formal agreement has been announced by either side, so final price, ownership percentage, financing and governance remain unconfirmed. If negotiations succeed, Royal Caribbean will extend from cruises into the Caribbean all‑inclusive resort market; if not, the proposed terms may never be realized.

items.title: 甲骨文裁員衝擊開發人員與工程師 雲端基礎架構部門成重災區
items.title_en: Oracle Layoffs Hit Developers and Engineers, Cloud Infrastructure Division Becomes Epicenter
paras: 《Business Insider》取得的一份文件顯示，甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)最新一輪裁員對雲端基礎架構部門的軟體開發人員、工程師及經理的影響最為嚴重。這份文件目前提供了最清楚資訊，說明上周裁員究竟影響了哪些員工。
根據該文件，甲骨文美洲雲端基礎架構(America Cloud Infrastructure)組織共有546 名員工遭到裁撤，相當於該組織7,185名員工中的7.6%。甲骨文表示，公布這些資訊是為了遵守聯邦年齡歧視法規。

在文件列出的所有職稱中，第3級軟體開發人員(software developer III)離職人數最多，共有57人失去工作。若計算所有職級，軟體開發人員約占此次裁員總數的17%。根據《Business Insider》報導，核心基礎架構首席工程師(principal core infrastructure engineer)與第4級專案經理(program manager IV)也是受影響最嚴重的職位之一。
若以整個雲端基礎架構部門統計，職稱中包含「經理」一詞的職位共有128人遭到裁撤，接近文件所列全部裁員人數的四分之一。《Business Insider》分析，單是專案經理職位就有61人遭到裁撤。
甲骨文的資料中心支援服務部門也受到明顯衝擊，共有41名員工被裁，其中包括該部門的副總裁及兩名資深總監。
文件中列出的多數員工都已經超過40歲，約每6人中就有1人至少60歲。
甲骨文並未公布上周總計裁員多少人。在最新一輪裁員之前，公司約有14.1萬名員工。截至2026年5月31日會計年度期間，甲骨文已裁撤約2.1萬個職位，約占員工總數的13%。公司當時表示，部分裁員與AI技術部署有關。
最新一輪裁員發生之際，甲骨文正面臨AI資料中心擴建帶來的資本支出大幅增加。甲骨文的雲端基礎架構部門在最近一季營收年增121%，仍是公司最重要的成長引擎之一。公司表示，2027會計年度計劃投入900億至950億美元興建資料中心。
甲骨文財務長Hilary Maxson上周在全公司會議上告訴員工，不應將這次裁員理解為要求員工「用更少的資源完成更多工作」。
甲骨文表示，此次裁員背後的重組計畫預計總成本約為28億美元，截至8月31日已認列約21億美元的相關費用。
paras_en: A document obtained by Business Insider shows that Oracle's (ORCL-US) latest round of layoffs hit software developers, engineers and managers in the cloud infrastructure division the hardest. The document currently provides the clearest information about which employees were affected by last week's cuts.

According to the document, Oracle's America Cloud Infrastructure organization saw 546 employees eliminated, representing 7.6% of the unit's 7,185 staff. Oracle said it disclosed the data to comply with federal age‑discrimination regulations.

Among all titles listed, Software Developer III had the highest number of departures, with 57 people losing their jobs. Across all levels, software developers accounted for roughly 17% of the total layoffs. Business Insider reported that Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer and Program Manager IV were also among the most affected roles.

Looking at the entire cloud infrastructure division, positions containing the word “manager” saw 128 people cut, close to a quarter of all layoffs listed in the document. Business Insider noted that project managers alone accounted for 61 cuts.
Oracle's data‑center support services division was also hit noticeably, with 41 employees laid off, including the division’s vice president and two senior directors.
Most of the employees listed in the document are over 40 years old, with about one in six being at least 60.

Oracle did not disclose the total number of people laid off last week. Prior to this latest round, the company had about 141,000 employees. As of the fiscal year ending May 31, 2026, Oracle had eliminated roughly 21,000 positions, about 13% of its workforce, saying some cuts were tied to AI technology deployment.

The latest layoffs come as Oracle faces sharply higher capital spending from AI data‑center expansion. The cloud infrastructure segment posted a 121% year‑over‑year revenue increase in the most recent quarter, remaining a key growth engine. The company said it plans to invest $90‑95 billion in data‑center construction in fiscal 2027.
Chief Financial Officer Hilary Maxson told employees at a company‑wide meeting last week that the layoffs should not be interpreted as a demand to “do more with fewer resources.”
Oracle said the restructuring behind the layoffs is expected to cost about $2.8 billion in total, with roughly $2.1 billion of related expenses already recognized as of August 31.

items.title: 花旗調查：通膨已成為家族辦公室頭號擔憂 正加速佈局黄金與股票
items.title_en: Citi Survey: Inflation Becomes Top Concern for Family Offices, Accelerating Gold and Stock Allocation
paras: 根據花旗最新發布的《2026年全球家族辦公室報告》，通膨已成為超高淨值投資者最擔心的問題。報告涵蓋40多國、逾350個家族辦公室，這項在今年6-7月進行的調查聚焦在他們如何在充滿不確定性的環境下，應對日益複雜的投資及財富管理挑戰。
與上一輪調查相比，通膨已取代貿易戰和關稅，排到風險關注首位，利率變化和全球金融體系穩定性緊隨其後。
花旗財富管理負責人Andy Sieg表示，家族辦公室雖關注通膨與營運成本，但未全面撤出風險資產。
逾90%接受花旗調查的機構表示，今年投資組合實現正收益，今年上半年近半數加碼上市股票，公開股票成為未來淨增配最偏好資產類別。
黃金配置同步攀升。Sieg指出，當前幾乎每次客戶會談都涉及黃金，兩年前並非如此。一部分全球家族開始將黃金視為貨幣配置一部分，主要因為多個已開發經濟體面臨財政壓力與通膨問題。花旗已擴大倫敦貴金屬金庫能力，加入少數提供黃金儲存與清算的銀行之列。
數據顯示，即便聯準會(Fed)上周三(16日)升息1碼，為2023年來首次，黃金仍展現韌性。黃金ETF連3月淨流入，9月以來吸引約50噸資金。
道明證券分析師表示，能源價格回落提供支撐，長期配置資金趁回檔增加曝險。
整體而言，家族辦公室操作呈兩層特徵：一方面增持上市股票等風險資產，另一方面將黃金納入配置，以應對通膨、利率及金融體系穩定性風險。花旗則擴大貴金屬基礎設施，直接回應富裕客戶對實體黃金與清算服務的上升需求，顯示通膨與利率環境已重塑家族辦公室的資產配置邏輯。
paras_en: According to Citi’s newly released “2026 Global Family Office Report,” inflation has become the greatest worry for ultra‑high‑net‑worth investors. The report covers more than 40 countries and over 350 family offices; the survey, conducted in June‑July this year, focuses on how they are coping with increasingly complex investment and wealth‑management challenges in an uncertain environment.

Compared with the previous survey round, inflation has overtaken trade wars and tariffs to become the top risk concern, with interest‑rate changes and the stability of the global financial system following closely behind.
Andy Sieg, head of Citi Wealth Management, said that while family offices are focused on inflation and operating costs, they have not fully withdrawn from risky assets.

More than 90% of the institutions that responded to Citi’s survey said their portfolios posted positive returns this year, and nearly half increased their holdings of listed equities in the first half of the year, making public stocks the most preferred asset class for future net‑new allocations.

Gold allocations are rising in tandem. Sieg noted that almost every client meeting now involves gold, which was not the case two years ago. Some global families are beginning to treat gold as part of their currency allocation, mainly because several developed economies are facing fiscal pressure and inflation. Citi has expanded the capacity of its London precious‑metals vault, joining the small group of banks that offer gold storage and clearing services.

Data show that even after the Federal Reserve raised rates by one basis point on Wednesday the 16th – the first hike in 2023 – gold remained resilient. Gold ETFs have seen net inflows for three consecutive months, attracting roughly 50 tonnes of capital since September.
Analysts at TD Securities said that the pull‑back in energy prices provides support, and that long‑term capital can increase exposure by buying on the dip.

Overall, family office activity shows a two‑pronged pattern: on one hand, they are adding to risky assets such as listed equities; on the other, they are incorporating gold into portfolios to hedge against inflation, interest‑rate, and financial‑system stability risks. Citi is expanding its precious‑metals infrastructure to directly meet the growing demand from wealthy clients for physical gold and clearing services, underscoring how the inflation and rate environment has reshaped family offices’ asset‑allocation logic.

items.title: NAND不再只是儲存商品 SanDisk目標價喊到2400美元、還能漲30％
items.title_en: NAND Is No Longer Just a Storage Commodity – SanDisk’s Target Price Hits $2,400, Still Up 30%
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體與儲存需求激增下，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 股價今年大幅飆升。隨著相關技術快速發展，分析師認為，該公司的業務定位正迎來轉變。
SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體過去通常被視為大宗儲存產品，但 Rosenblatt 分析師凱西迪（Kevin Cassidy）在最新報告中指出，新一代 AI 系統正為 NAND 創造重新定位的機會，使其從一般儲存產品轉變為 AI 基礎設施中更關鍵的系統元件。
凱西迪也首次將 SanDisk 納入追蹤研究，給予買進評等。NAND 快閃記憶體屬於非揮發性記憶體，這意味著它能在無須持續供電的情況下保存資料。
凱西迪表示，過去個人電腦、智慧手機及其他消費電子產品對 NAND 的需求，主要由儲存密度提升與每位元成本下降所驅動。
儲存密度是指 NAND 快閃記憶體在一定實體空間內可容納的資料量，每位元成本則是 NAND 記憶單元儲存每單位資料的成本。
不過，隨著 AI 模型規模擴大，加上推論程序需要處理大量資料，市場考量正從追求最低絕對價格，逐漸轉向更重視儲存密度、效能、耐用度及供應穩定性。所謂推論，是指 AI 模型依據已學習的模式進行預測。
SanDisk 的技術藍圖涵蓋與日本鎧俠（Kioxia）共同開發的 BiCS8 與 BiCS10 架構，透過垂直堆疊記憶體單元，在更小的空間內實現更高儲存容量，這項優勢完美呼應了凱西迪所看好的願景，將使 NAND 「進一步提升其對整體 AI 系統的價值」。
在凱西迪看來，SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體技術能在合適的成本下實現更高密度，這將有助於其在大型 AI 儲存產品領域中，「維持效能與成本的雙重優勢」。
他預估，SanDisk 於 6 月底展開的 2027 會計年度，資料中心整體營收將達 217 億美元，並在 2028 會計年度進一步增至 286 億美元。
凱西迪給予 SanDisk 目標價 2,400 美元，較該股周二早盤的 1,849.75 美元仍有約 30% 上漲空間。
此外，凱西迪也提到 SanDisk 新推出的商業模式協議，目前已與八家主要 NAND 客戶達成合作。隨著 AI 需求持續造成 NAND 供應短缺，這類多年期合約可讓客戶依特定價格確保供貨。
這些協議將涵蓋 SanDisk 大部分 NAND 產能。凱西迪表示，此舉可望提高需求能見度，並降低 NAND 產業過往常見的景氣循環波動。
paras_en: Amid the AI‑driven surge in memory and storage demand, SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) shares have rocketed this year. As related technologies evolve rapidly, analysts say the company’s business positioning is undergoing a shift.

SanDisk’s NAND flash memory has traditionally been viewed as a bulk storage product, but Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy noted in his latest report that new‑generation AI systems are creating an opportunity to reposition NAND, turning it from a generic storage item into a more critical component of AI infrastructure.
Cassidy also added SanDisk to his coverage for the first time, assigning a buy rating. NAND flash is a type of non‑volatile memory, meaning it can retain data without continuous power.
He explained that past demand for NAND from PCs, smartphones and other consumer electronics was driven mainly by higher storage density and lower cost per bit.
Storage density refers to the amount of data NAND flash can hold within a given physical space, while cost per bit is the expense of storing each unit of data in a NAND cell.

However, as AI model sizes grow and inference workloads require processing massive data volumes, the market is shifting from chasing the lowest absolute price to placing greater emphasis on density, performance, durability and supply stability. Inference means an AI model makes predictions based on patterns it has learned.

SanDisk’s technology roadmap includes the BiCS8 and BiCS10 architectures co‑developed with Japan’s Kioxia, which stack memory cells vertically to achieve higher capacity in a smaller footprint—an advantage that aligns perfectly with Cassidy’s vision of further enhancing NAND’s value to overall AI systems.
According to Cassidy, SanDisk’s NAND flash can deliver higher density at an acceptable cost, helping it maintain both performance and cost advantages in the large‑scale AI storage market.
He projects that for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, SanDisk’s data‑center revenue will reach $21.7 billion, rising to $28.6 billion in fiscal 2028.
Cassidy set a target price of $2,400 for SanDisk, roughly a 30% upside from the stock’s early‑day price of $1,849.75 on Tuesday.

He also noted that SanDisk has recently launched a commercial‑model agreement, already securing deals with eight major NAND customers. As AI demand continues to tighten NAND supply, these multi‑year contracts let customers lock in supply at predetermined prices.
These agreements will cover most of SanDisk’s NAND capacity. Cassidy said the move should improve demand visibility and dampen the cyclical volatility that has historically plagued the NAND industry.

items.title: 伊朗擬重罰未授權過境荷姆茲船隻 貨值20%罰款 拒付就扣押
items.title_en: Iran Plans Heavier Penalties for Unauthorized Passage Through the Strait of Hormuz, 20% Cargo Value Fine, Detention for Non‑Payment
paras: 荷姆茲海峽重開前景再現反覆之際，伊朗方面傳出更嚴格的海峽通行管控措施：未經授權通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻，可能面臨相當於所載貨物價值20%的罰款，拒絕繳納罰款的船隻，將被暫時扣押。
據伊朗媒體《法爾斯通訊社》22日（周二）報導，伊朗議會國家安全委員會發言人哈桑·卡什卡維表示，該委員會已經批准荷姆茲海峽的新法律條款。
根據這些條款，違反海峽通行規定的船隻，除需繳納相當於貨物價值20%的罰款外，還會被暫時扣押，直至罰款繳清。
按照《法爾斯通訊社》披露的細節，伊朗此次擬實施的規定不僅涉及罰款和扣船，還配套建立司法和軍事層面執行機制。
伊朗司法部門將設立專門的司法分支，由熟悉海事法和國際海洋法的法官及專家負責相關案件，以確保規定得到嚴格執行。
與此同時，伊朗武裝部隊總參謀部或國防部將每三個月向議會國家安全與外交政策委員會提交一次執行情況報告。
值得注意的是，這一消息傳出同一天，據《路透社》報導，一名伊朗高階官員表示，如果美國降低軍事壓力，解除對伊朗港口的封鎖，伊朗可以在7天內重新開放荷姆茲海峽。
但隨後，《法爾斯通訊社》又援引伊朗消息人士否認「7天重開」協議的報導。在外交信號與海峽管控措施同時出現的背景下，荷姆茲海峽通行安排依然充滿不確定性。
paras_en: As the prospect of reopening the Strait of Hormuz continues to fluctuate, Iran has announced even stricter transit controls: vessels that pass through the strait without authorization could face a fine equal to 20% of the cargo’s value, and ships that refuse to pay the fine will be temporarily detained.

According to Iran’s state news agency Fars on Tuesday, the 22nd, spokesperson Hassan Kashkavi of the National Security Committee of the Iranian Parliament said the committee has approved new legal provisions for the Strait of Hormuz.
Under these provisions, ships that violate the strait’s transit rules must pay a fine equal to 20% of the cargo’s value and will be temporarily seized until the fine is settled.
Fars disclosed that the proposed regulations not only involve fines and vessel detention but also include the establishment of judicial and military enforcement mechanisms.

Iran’s judiciary will create a dedicated judicial branch staffed by judges and experts versed in maritime and international ocean law to handle related cases and ensure strict enforcement of the rules.

At the same time, the Iranian Armed Forces’ General Staff or the Ministry of Defense will submit an execution‑status report to the Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Committee every three months.

It is noteworthy that on the same day the news broke, Reuters reported that a senior Iranian official said if the United States reduces military pressure and lifts the blockade on Iranian ports, Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

However, Fars later quoted Iranian sources denying the report of a “seven‑day reopening” agreement. Amid simultaneous diplomatic signals and strait‑control measures, the transit arrangements for the Strait of Hormuz remain highly uncertain.

items.title: 敏感時機引關注！川普7月買進最多5萬美元Space X股票 隨後逢高減碼
items.title_en: Sensitive Timing Draws Attention! Trump Bought Up to $50,000 of SpaceX Stock in July, Then Trimmed at Peaks
paras: 根據公開的財務申報文件，美國總統川普7月買進最多5萬美元的SpaceX(SPCX-US)股票，同時賣出最多1.5萬美元持股。
根據川普9月8日簽署的財務申報文件，他在7月10日買進價值15,001美元至5萬美元的SpaceX股票。同一份申報文件顯示，他在7月17日賣出價值1001美元至15,000美元的SpaceX股票。
SpaceX是馬斯克旗下火箭公司，也是美國軍方承包商，也經常需要取得聯邦政府機構的核准，最新交易加深了川普與SpaceX的財務連結，時間正值美國政府準備做出可能影響SpaceX業務前景的決策。

SpaceX估值達1.77兆美元

SpaceX在6月12日以1.77兆美元估值定價，創下美國史上規模最大的首次公開發行(IPO)紀錄，這家企業提供太空、衛星及人工智慧(AI)服務。
在川普進行這兩筆交易的7月10日至17日期間，SpaceX股價下跌15%。
川普6月也曾買進SpaceX股票。白宮發言人Davis Ingle當時表示，相關交易由第三方金融機構獨立管理總統的投資組合，並複製「嘉信1000(Schwab 1000)等獲認可的指數」。

川普7月交易逾千筆

負責蒐集美國政府官員倫理申報資料的政府倫理辦公室(Office of Government Ethics)，周二在網站上公布財務申報，而這兩筆交易是川普7月進行的逾1000筆交易之一。
川普這筆投資的確切金額難以立即確定，原因是聯邦官員在財務申報表上申報資產價值時，採用的是區間而非精確金額。
paras_en: According to publicly filed financial disclosure documents, U.S. President Donald Trump bought as much as $50,000 worth of SpaceX (SPCX‑US) stock in July, while also selling up to $15,000 of his holdings.

The disclosure filed on September 8 shows that on July 10 he purchased SpaceX shares valued between $15,001 and $50,000, and the same filing indicates that on July 17 he sold SpaceX shares worth between $1,001 and $15,000.

SpaceX is Elon Musk’s rocket company, a U.S. military contractor that frequently needs approval from federal agencies; the latest trades deepen Trump’s financial link to SpaceX at a time when the U.S. government is preparing decisions that could affect the company’s business outlook.
SpaceX was valued at $1.77 trillion on June 12, setting a record as the largest initial public offering in U.S. history; the firm provides space, satellite and artificial‑intelligence services.
During the period of Trump’s two trades, from July 10 to July 17, SpaceX’s share price fell 15%.

Trump also bought SpaceX stock in June. At the time, White House spokesperson Davis Ingle said the transactions were managed independently by a third‑party financial institution that mirrors approved indices such as the Schwab 1000.
Trump’s July trades were part of more than 1,000 transactions he made that month, according to the Office of Government Ethics, which posted the disclosures on its website on Tuesday.
The exact amount of Trump’s investment is hard to pin down immediately because federal officials report asset values in ranges rather than precise figures on their financial disclosure forms.

items.title: 胡塞警告土耳其、巴基斯坦 勿介入衝突
items.title_en: Houthi Leader Warns Turkey and Pakistan Not to Join Conflict
paras: 葉門叛軍胡塞領導人阿卜杜勒·馬利克·胡塞21日（周一）晚警告土耳其和巴基斯坦不要介入胡塞與沙烏地阿拉伯不斷升級的衝突。
阿卜杜勒·馬利克在馬西拉電視台播出的電視講話中說，沙國在與胡塞衝突不斷升級之際，尋求土耳其和巴基斯坦提供軍事支援。他敦促兩國不要為了與沙國的政治或經濟利益而捲入這場衝突。
談及局勢緩和的可能性時，阿卜杜勒·馬利克說，胡塞並沒有提出「不可能實現的條件」，並重申要求沙國停止軍事行動和封鎖。
此外，他還在講話中繼續動員支持者，並表示在衝突不斷升級的背景下，將繼續加強軍事能力。
近期胡塞與支持葉門政府軍的沙國之間衝突持續升級，雙方相互發動飛彈、無人機襲擊。
paras_en: Yemen's rebel Houthi leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi warned Turkey and Pakistan on Monday evening not to intervene in the escalating conflict between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia.

In a televised speech broadcast on Masirah TV, Abdul-Malik said Saudi Arabia, amid the intensifying clash with the Houthis, is seeking military support from Turkey and Pakistan. He urged the two countries not to get drawn into the war for political or economic gains tied to Saudi interests.

When asked about the prospect of de‑escalation, Abdul-Malik said the Houthis have not set any "unrealistic conditions" and reiterated their demand that Saudi Arabia halt its military actions and blockade.
He also used the speech to rally his supporters, stating that amid the rising hostilities the Houthis will continue to strengthen their military capabilities.
Recently, clashes between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government forces, have intensified, with both sides launching missile and drone attacks on each other.

items.title: 川習二會美中代表團對比鮮明！美CEO陣容豪華、中方傳企業高層缺席 兩國商業成果預期偏低
items.title_en: Trump‑Xi Summit Shows Stark Contrast Between US and Chinese Delegations: US CEOs Are Star‑Studded, Chinese Senior Executives Absent, and Business Outcomes Expected to Be Modest
paras: 備受期待的川習會本周將匯聚大批美國企業領袖，但中國方面恐怕不會有規模相當的企業代表團，讓外界對世界兩大經濟體本周能否達成新的商業協議打上問號。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)報導，一些了解習近平訪美行程的產業官員原本預期，中國將籌組一個由企業高層組成的代表團陪同習近平訪美，並與美國多名科技及人工智慧(AI)企業執行長一同出席川普周四舉行的國宴。
《彭博》也引述一名美國政府高級官員說法報導，中國國家主席習近平預料不會以商業代表團形式帶領企業執行長赴美。
然而川普上周告訴記者，他預期此次峰會將達成「很多不同的協議」。
中國企業代表團可能缺席，凸顯外界對世界兩大經濟體領袖會晤能否取得重大商業成果的預期偏低。
近年來，美中關係因多項議題陷入緊張，包括美國對中國商品加徵關稅、美國對晶片出口實施管制，以及中國限制對美出口對美國產業至關重要的稀土磁鐵。這樣的政治緊張局勢限制了大型中國企業赴美投資生產的能力，而這通常是外國企業執行長訪問華盛頓時的重要議題。

美國科技巨頭齊聚 中國企業高層料缺席

美國方面，預定出席國宴的美國科技企業高層包括Meta Platforms(META-US)執行長祖克伯(Mark Zuckerberg)、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、微軟(MSFT-US)執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、蘋果(AAPL-US)董事長庫克(Tim Cook)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)，以及戴爾科技(DELL-US)創辦人戴爾(Michael Dell)。
此外，花旗集團(C-US)執行長Jane Fraser及摩根大通(JPM-US)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)也將出席。
知情人士透露，其他參與峰會的人士還包括川普政府負責經濟及貿易政策的高級官員，包括商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)、財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)、能源部長萊特(Chris Wright)及美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)等。
儘管相關安排及出席名單仍可能改變，但美方企業高層陣容明顯較為龐大，反映出美中雙方對這場峰會的期待可能存在差異。
川普一再表達對此次峰會的期待，稱習近平訪美是「非常大的榮耀」，並強調自己與中國領導人之間的良好關係。

川普面臨期中選舉壓力 習近平有經濟放緩考驗

此次會晤正值川普面臨政治壓力之際。共和黨將在11月迎接期中選舉，屆時可能失去眾議院或參議院其中一院，甚至兩院，進而限制川普未來兩年的施政議程。
另一方面，習近平則正邁向外界預期的第四個任期，然而中國經濟成長正在放緩。
習近平2015年訪問美國時，曾帶領規模龐大的中國企業代表團，包括阿里巴巴(Alibaba)(BABA-US)創辦人馬雲(Jack Ma)、騰訊(Tencent)(00700-HK)執行長馬化騰(Pony Ma)，以及其他中國國營企業高層。
而川普今年5月訪問北京時，馬斯克和等美國企業高層曾陪同川普訪問中國。
然而這場川習二會登場前夕，美中在人工智慧、關鍵礦產出口及台灣等議題上的緊張情勢持續升溫。格里爾本周稍早受訪時表示，美中在延長貿易休戰的條件上仍存在分歧。

白宮宴會廳空間不足 也成川普抱怨焦點

儘管實質內容可能有限，習近平此次訪問華盛頓將有相當高規格的儀式安排，這是習近平11年來首次訪問華盛頓。
川普將罕見親自前往安德魯斯聯合基地(Joint Base Andrews)迎接習近平抵達。川普今年5月訪問北京時，習近平則派遣下屬官員前往機場迎接川普。
川普預定周四為習近平及夫人彭麗媛舉行國賓歡迎儀式。第一夫人辦公室表示，儀式將有479名軍事人員參與。隨後川普與習近平將舉行峰會會談，之後舉行國宴。
峰會代表團規模的考量因素之一，可能與場地空間有關。川普這幾個月來一直抱怨白宮缺乏足夠空間舉行大型活動，並以需要接待習近平的國宴等場合為由，替在白宮園區興建大型宴會廳的計畫辯護。
川普上周表示，國宴將在「一個非常小的房間」舉行，並抱怨他希望興建的白宮宴會廳尚未完工。
川普說：「我真的可以告訴你，成千上萬的人都希望能參加那場晚宴。」
paras_en: The highly anticipated Trump‑Xi summit this week will bring a large number of US corporate leaders, but China is unlikely to send an equally sized business delegation, raising doubts about whether the two world’s biggest economies can strike new commercial deals this week.

The Wall Street Journal reported that industry officials familiar with Xi’s U.S. itinerary had expected China to assemble a delegation of senior corporate executives to accompany Xi on his visit and to attend Thursday’s state dinner alongside several US technology and artificial‑intelligence (AI) CEOs.
Bloomberg also quoted a senior US government official saying that President Xi is not expected to lead a business delegation of CEOs to the United States.
However, Trump told reporters last week that he expects the summit to produce “a lot of different agreements.”
The possible absence of a Chinese corporate delegation underscores the low expectations that the leaders of the two major economies will achieve significant commercial results from their meeting.

In recent years, US‑China relations have become strained over multiple issues, including US tariffs on Chinese goods, US restrictions on chip exports, and China’s limits on rare‑earth magnets that are vital to US industry. This political tension has curtailed large Chinese firms’ ability to invest and produce in the United States, a topic that usually dominates CEOs’ visits to Washington.

US tech giants will gather, while senior Chinese executives are expected to be missing.  The US side’s planned attendees for the state dinner include Meta Platforms (META‑US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) CEO Satya Nadella, Amazon (AMZN‑US) founder Jeff Bezos, Apple (AAPL‑US) chairman Tim Cook, Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) CEO Sundar Pichai, and Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) founder Michael Dell.
In addition, Citigroup (C‑US) CEO Jane Fraser and JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) CEO Jamie Dimon are also slated to attend.

Insiders say other participants include senior Trump‑administration officials responsible for economic and trade policy, such as Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Energy Secretary Chris Wright, and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer.

Although the exact arrangements and attendance list could still change, the US corporate roster is clearly much larger, reflecting a possible difference in expectations between the two sides for the summit.
Trump has repeatedly expressed his enthusiasm for the summit, calling Xi’s visit “a very great honor” and emphasizing the good relationship he has with Chinese leaders.

Trump faces pressure from the upcoming midterm elections. The Republican Party will hold its midterms in November, which could cost it control of the House, the Senate, or both, limiting Trump’s agenda for the next two years.
Meanwhile, Xi is moving toward what is expected to be his fourth term, even as China’s economic growth is slowing.

When Xi visited the United States in 2015, he led a massive Chinese corporate delegation that included Alibaba (BABA‑US) founder Jack Ma, Tencent (00700‑HK) CEO Pony Ma, and other senior officials from state‑owned enterprises.
During Trump’s May visit to Beijing, Elon Musk and other US corporate leaders accompanied the president on his trip to China.

However, on the eve of this second Trump‑Xi meeting, tensions between the US and China over AI, critical mineral exports and Taiwan have continued to rise. Greer said earlier this week that the two sides still disagree on the conditions for extending the trade truce.

The White House banquet hall’s limited space has also become a focus of Trump’s complaints. Although the substantive agenda may be limited, Xi’s visit to Washington will feature a fairly high‑profile ceremonial schedule, marking his first visit to the capital in 11 years.
Trump will unusually travel in person to Joint Base Andrews to greet Xi on arrival. When Trump visited Beijing in May, Xi sent subordinates to the airport to receive him.

Trump has scheduled a state‑guest welcome ceremony on Thursday for Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan. The First Lady’s office said 479 military personnel will take part. Afterward, Trump and Xi will hold summit talks followed by a state dinner.

One factor in determining the size of the summit delegations may be venue space. Trump has spent the past few months complaining that the White House lacks sufficient room for large events and has used the need to host Xi’s state dinner as a justification for building a new large banquet hall on the White House grounds.
Last week Trump said the state dinner would be held “in a very small room” and lamented that the banquet hall he wants built is still unfinished.
Trump said, “I can really tell you, thousands and thousands of people want to attend that dinner.”

paras: 2026年09月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股周二漲跌互見，AI相關晶片股延續漲勢，帶動那斯達克指數連續第二個交易日刷新收盤新高，標普500指數則在歷史高點附近震盪。另一方面，國際油價徘徊每桶100美元附近，美國10年期公債殖利率接近4.94%，加上軟體與金融股走弱，限制大盤漲幅。
美股四大指數方面，標普500指數近乎持平，收在7,764.64點，距8月13日創下的歷史收盤高點不到0.5%；那斯達克指數上漲0.45%，收27,244.28點，連續第二個交易日改寫收盤新高；道瓊工業指數下跌0.36%，收51,863.69點。
市場交易主軸仍圍繞AI。Meta Platforms(META-US)本月推出AI助理Muse，可代替使用者發送電子郵件及完成交易，市場反應熱烈，也進一步推升近期AI相關晶片股表現。美光Micron Technology(MU-US)收盤大漲5%，SanDisk(SNDK-US)上漲近7%。
不過，Muse快速切入消費服務領域，也讓市場開始評估AI代理（AI Agent）可能對既有網路平台商業模式帶來的競爭壓力。市場擔憂，這類AI助理未來可能進一步介入保險管理、旅遊預訂、商品搜尋及金融服務，亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)周一已禁止Muse透過其平台購物。
相關疑慮拖累部分消費服務與平台股走弱。叫車平台Uber Technologies(UBER-US)與Lyft(LYFT-US)均下跌超過1%，Airbnb(ABNB-US)下跌3%，嘉信理財Charles Schwab(SCHW-US)跌幅更達6.1%。
Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek表示，當日不少科技股受到不同程度的Muse相關疑慮影響，市場開始擔心AI代理未來可能直接替使用者管理保險、預訂旅遊行程及搜尋購物商品，進而改變既有平台與消費者之間的互動方式。
除了AI題材外，油價與美債殖利率也是市場焦點。國際油價在每桶100美元附近震盪，美國10年期公債殖利率則徘徊4.94%左右。美國總統川普在聯合國大會演說中警告，若無法就結束中東衝突達成協議，美國可能對伊朗採取進一步行動，使市場持續關注地緣政治風險及能源價格走勢。
投資人同時等待周四登場的美中峰會。市場關注雙方是否延長目前的貿易休戰安排，以及會談是否觸及AI監管議題。Themis Trading股票市場結構研究主管Joe Saluzzi表示，市場期待雙方至少能啟動相關討論，尋求建立全球性框架的可能性。
類股方面，標普500指數11大類股中有6個收黑，其中金融類股下跌1.68%，跌幅居前，通訊服務類股下跌0.8%。摩根大通JPMorgan Chase(JPM-US)與富國銀行Wells Fargo(WFC-US)均下跌超過3%。
利率方面，波士頓聯準銀行總裁Susan Collins表示，由於仍存在通膨風險，她支持聯準會上周升息；紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams則表示，聯準會目前控制短期利率的政策框架，在支持金融市場運作方面仍然有效。
根據CME Group FedWatch Tool，交易員目前預估聯準會10月升息至少25個基點的機率為53%，利率走向仍是影響後續美股評價的重要變數。
市場交投熱絡，美國交易所全天成交量約179億股，高於過去20個交易日平均的163億股。標普500指數上漲與下跌家數大致相當，當日出現9檔創新高、16檔創新低；那斯達克市場則有48檔創新高、110檔創新低。

paras_en: On Tuesday, U.S. equities showed mixed moves while AI‑related chip stocks continued to rise, propelling the Nasdaq index to a second consecutive day of record closing highs. The S&P 500 hovered near its historic peak, while international oil prices lingered around $100 a barrel and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield approached 4.94%, with weaker software and financial stocks capping broader gains.

The four major U.S. indexes saw the S&P 500 essentially flat at 7,764.64 points, just under 0.5% shy of its August 13 historic close. The Nasdaq rose 0.45% to 27,244.28, marking a second straight day of new closing highs, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.36% to 51,863.69.

The market’s focus remained on AI. Meta Platforms (META‑US) launched its AI assistant Muse this month, which can draft emails and execute trades for users, sparking strong market enthusiasm and further boosting recent AI‑related chip stocks. Micron Technology (MU‑US) surged 5% at the close, and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rose nearly 7%.

However, Muse’s rapid entry into consumer services has prompted the market to assess the competitive pressure AI agents could place on existing online platforms. Concerns grew that such assistants might eventually handle insurance management, travel bookings, product searches and financial services, leading Amazon (AMZN‑US) to ban Muse from shopping on its platform on Monday.

These worries weighed on several consumer‑service and platform stocks. Ride‑hailing firms Uber Technologies (UBER‑US) and Lyft (LYFT‑US) each fell more than 1%, Airbnb (ABNB‑US) dropped 3%, and Charles Schwab (SCHW‑US) slid 6.1%.

Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management, said many tech stocks that day were affected to varying degrees by Muse‑related concerns, as the market worries AI agents could directly manage insurance, travel itineraries and shopping for users, reshaping the interaction between platforms and consumers.

Beyond AI, oil prices and U.S. bond yields were also in focus. International crude hovered near $100 per barrel and the 10‑year Treasury yield lingered around 4.94%. In a UN General Assembly speech, President Trump warned that if a cease‑fire agreement in the Middle East is not reached, the U.S. may take further action against Iran, keeping geopolitical risk and energy price trends in the spotlight.

Investors also awaited Thursday’s U.S.–China summit, watching whether the two sides would extend the current trade‑war truce and if AI regulation would be on the agenda. Joe Saluzzi, head of market‑structure research at Themis Trading, said the market hopes the talks will at least launch discussions toward a global framework.
Sector‑wise, six of the S&P 500’s 11 sectors closed lower, with financials down 1.68% and communications services down 0.8%. JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) and Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) each fell more than 3%.

On rates, Boston Fed President Susan Collins said she supports the Fed’s recent hike given lingering inflation risks, while New York Fed President John Williams noted that the current policy framework for controlling short‑term rates remains effective in supporting market functioning.

According to the CME Group FedWatch Tool, traders currently assign a 53% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points in October, making the rate path a key factor for future U.S. equity valuations.

Trading was brisk, with U.S. exchanges handling about 17.9 billion shares throughout the day, above the 20‑day average of 16.3 billion. The S&P 500 saw a roughly even split between advancing and declining stocks, with 9 hitting new highs and 16 new lows; the Nasdaq recorded 48 new highs and 110 new lows.

paras: 美國總統川普週二 (22 日) 在聯合國大會發表演說，警告若無法與伊朗達成終戰協議，他可能迅速「殲滅伊朗」。不過，他同時預測，美伊可望在 11 月 3 日期中選舉後達成和平協議。
川普表示，他正面臨一項重大決定：究竟是與伊朗達成協議，讓該國重建並變得更加強大，還是迅速摧毀伊朗政權，使其無法再傷害其他國家與人民。
他呼籲各國配合美國，在經濟上孤立伊朗，迫使德黑蘭重返談判桌。
對於期中選舉可能影響美國對伊朗政策的說法，川普回應，伊朗領導階層正在觀望選舉結果，卻忽略他本人不需再次競選，而且任期仍有兩年半。
部分分析人士認為，若民主黨在期中選舉後掌控國會，川普處理伊朗戰事的籌碼可能受到削弱。
川普演說後告訴記者，美國官員當天與伊朗代表團進行約三小時且「非常順利」的會談。
不過，他隨後澄清，特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與庫許納 (Jared Kushner) 接觸的是伊朗的調解人，並非伊朗官員本人，並形容這場會談「富有成效」。
川普在長達 37 分鐘的演說中，將伊朗戰事置於其外交政策主軸，聲稱美國參戰已阻止德黑蘭取得核武。他也主張，美國必須維持在西半球的主導地位，避免安全威脅在當地立足。
談及美軍突襲委內瑞拉並逮捕該國領導人的行動，川普表示，這證明美國不會再容許威脅在西半球擴張。他宣稱：「其他人只談和平，我則締造了和平。」
川普也將矛頭指向墨西哥與古巴。他稱墨西哥是「販毒集團暴力的中心」，要求墨西哥政府重新掌控國土；談到古巴時則表示，美國正推動當地局勢出現「根本性改變」。
古巴代表團成員在川普提及美國對古巴的施壓行動時離開會場。川普形容古巴是「徹底失敗的國家」，並預測其政權最終將垮台。
在國際組織方面，川普再度批評聯合國官僚體系，但沒有提出新的攻擊，也未暗示美國將退出更多聯合國機構。他另點名國際刑事法院，強調不會允許美軍人員或其他美國公民接受他所稱「反美法庭」的調查或審判。
川普發表演說前不到一週，聯合國事實調查團表示，有合理理由相信美軍對伊朗的兩次空襲可能構成戰爭罪，其中一次攻擊擊中伊朗南部米納卜市一所小學。
談及人工智慧 (AI)，川普承認這項技術帶來挑戰，但強調不會壓抑一項規模可能超越工業革命的技術。
聯合國安全理事會預定週三討論 AI 與國際安全議題。
演說後，川普展開密集外交行程，先後會見英國、烏克蘭及日本領袖。
英國首相柏南 (Andy Burnham) 表示，兩人首次會談討論貿易、烏克蘭及福克蘭群島地位；日本首相高市早苗則稱，這場會談將在亞洲安全環境嚴峻之際，展現美日同盟的力量。
川普另與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基討論結束俄烏戰爭的方法，並預計本週稍晚在華府與中國國家主席習近平會晤。
外媒報導，伊朗已向美國提議重開荷姆茲海峽美軍解封「7天內」就重開，美伊局勢有趨緩跡象，布蘭特原油期貨週二下滑 1.09%，收每桶 99.25 美元；西德州原油期貨下跌 1.24%，收每桶 94.59 美元，連續第五個交易日收黑。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a speech at the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday (the 22nd), warning that if a final peace deal with Iran cannot be reached, he could swiftly “annihilate Iran.” He also predicted that the United States and Iran could reach a peace agreement after the November 3 mid‑term elections.

Trump said he faces a major decision: whether to strike a deal that would allow Iran to rebuild and become stronger, or to quickly destroy the Iranian regime so it can no longer harm other countries and peoples.
He called on other nations to cooperate with the United States in economically isolating Iran and forcing Tehran back to the negotiating table.

When asked whether the mid‑term elections might affect U.S. policy toward Iran, Trump replied that Iran’s leadership is watching the election results, but ignored the fact that he himself does not need to run again and still has two and a half years left in his term.
Some analysts believe that if Democrats control Congress after the mid‑terms, Trump’s leverage in dealing with the Iran conflict could be weakened.
After his speech, Trump told reporters that U.S. officials had a roughly three‑hour, “very smooth” meeting with an Iranian delegation that day.
He later clarified that envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were in contact with Iran’s mediators, not Iranian officials themselves, and described the talks as “productive.”

In his 37‑minute address, Trump placed the Iran war at the center of his foreign‑policy agenda, claiming U.S. involvement has prevented Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons and asserting that America must maintain dominance in the Western Hemisphere to keep security threats from taking root there.

Discussing a U.S. raid in Venezuela that captured the country’s leader, Trump said it showed America will no longer allow threats to expand in the Western Hemisphere. He declared, “Others only talk about peace; I create peace.”

Trump also pointed the finger at Mexico and Cuba. He called Mexico the “center of drug‑cartel violence,” demanding the Mexican government retake control of its territory; regarding Cuba he said the United States is pushing for a “fundamental change” in the island’s situation.
When Trump mentioned U.S. pressure on Cuba, members of the Cuban delegation left the hall. Trump described Cuba as a “totally failed state” and predicted its regime would eventually collapse.

Regarding international organizations, Trump again criticized United Nations bureaucracy but offered no new attacks and did not hint that the U.S. would withdraw from additional UN bodies. He singled out the International Criminal Court, emphasizing that U.S. personnel or other Americans will not be subject to what he called a “anti‑American court.”

Less than a week before his speech, a UN fact‑finding mission said there is reasonable cause to believe two U.S. airstrikes on Iran could constitute war crimes, one of which hit an elementary school in the southern city of Minab.
On the topic of artificial intelligence (AI), Trump acknowledged the technology poses challenges but stressed he would not suppress a technology whose scale could surpass the Industrial Revolution.
The UN Security Council is scheduled to discuss AI and international security on Wednesday.
After the speech, Trump embarked on an intensive diplomatic tour, meeting consecutively with leaders from the United Kingdom, Ukraine and Japan.

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the first meeting between the two leaders covered trade, Ukraine and the status of the Falkland Islands; Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said the talks would demonstrate the strength of the U.S.–Japan alliance amid a severe Asian security environment.
Trump also discussed ways to end the Russia‑Ukraine war with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and is expected to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping later this week in Washington.

Foreign media reported that Iran has offered the United States to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days of a U.S. lift of restrictions, indicating a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran relations; Brent crude futures fell 1.09% on Tuesday to $99.25 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate dropped 1.24% to $94.59, marking the fifth consecutive day of declines.

items.title: 皇家加勒比跨足陸上度假市場 傳砸30億美元取得Sandals半數股權
items.title_en: Royal Caribbean Moves into Land-Based Resorts, Said to Spend $3 Billion for Half of Sandals
paras: 皇家加勒比集團(RCL-US)正接近與加勒比海度假村業者 Sandals Resorts International 達成一項約30億美元的交易，計畫取得後者50%股權。若交易完成，Sandals整體估值將達約60億美元，也將讓皇家加勒比進一步從郵輪業務跨足陸上全包式度假市場。
知情人士透露，雙方目前仍在進行交易協商，皇家加勒比擬取得Sandals 50%股權，部分Stewart家族成員則可能繼續持有剩餘股權。按照目前討論中的架構，皇家加勒比將成為Sandals的控股股東，未來甚至不排除進一步取得Sandals全部股權。
不過，交易目前尚未完成，相關協商仍可能出現變化。知情人士指出，雙方最快可能在未來幾天內達成協議，但也不能排除談判最終破局的可能，因此30億美元交易規模、50%持股比例及約60億美元估值，目前都仍屬協商中的條件。
若交易落實，這將成為皇家加勒比歷來規模最大的收購交易之一，並進一步改變公司的業務版圖。皇家加勒比近年積極擴大郵輪以外的度假產品，除了經營郵輪航線，也持續發展私人目的地及陸上度假項目，而取得Sandals股權將使公司直接切入加勒比海全包式度假村市場。
Sandals及旗下Beaches品牌在加勒比海擁有超過十座度假村，相關業務涵蓋牙買加、巴哈馬、聖露西亞、格瑞那達、安提瓜、巴貝多及土克斯及開科斯群島等市場。另有報導指出，Sandals及Beaches合計約有20座度假村，若皇家加勒比取得控制權，將能進一步擴大其在加勒比海陸上旅遊市場的布局。
對皇家加勒比而言，Sandals的全包式度假模式與現有郵輪業務具有不同的產品型態。公司可以藉由郵輪與度假村之間的交叉銷售，讓旅客在郵輪假期之外增加陸上住宿選項，同時也有機會把Sandals既有客群導向皇家加勒比的郵輪產品。
皇家加勒比近年已明確將業務方向從單純郵輪業者擴展至更廣泛的度假平台。公司2026年第二季財報顯示，集團旗下全球品牌及合作品牌合計營運71艘船，航線涵蓋全球120多個國家的逾1,000個目的地。公司同時持續投資陸上目的地，2026年全年資本支出預估約47億美元，其中包括新船訂單及陸上目的地相關投資。
皇家加勒比此前也表示，正在建立更廣泛的度假平台，希望讓旅客在更多不同場合選擇旗下產品。公司2026年第二季業績中指出，消費者對度假體驗的需求仍然強勁，2027年的預訂趨勢亦較歷史水準領先。
Sandals方面，品牌近年也持續進行大規模擴張及升級。2026年公司曾公布，Beaches品牌未來5至6年將新增5座度假村，並投入接近10億美元進行開發及既有度假村升級，包括牙買加、巴貝多、巴哈馬及聖文森等市場。此外，Sandals Montego Bay及Sandals Royal Caribbean等既有度假村也規劃進行大規模改造。
此次交易消息傳出後，皇家加勒比股價一度下跌約6%, 市場對這筆大型交易的反應受到關注。皇家加勒比股價過去一年亦累計下跌約25%, 公司近期曾調整營收成長預期，歐洲郵輪需求變化成為市場關注因素之一。
不過，皇家加勒比近期基本營運表現仍維持一定動能。公司2026年第二季淨利約11億美元，較2025年同期約12億美元略降；2026年前6個月淨利約21億美元，高於去年同期約19億美元。第二季營收較去年同期增加2.94億美元，前6個月營收則增加7.47億美元。
公司預期2026年第三季營收將年增約8%, 淨收益率預計大致持平，並預估第三季調整後每股盈餘介於6.26至6.36美元。截至2026年6月底，皇家加勒比仍有8.05億美元股票回購授權額度。
對Sandals而言，這筆交易則可能為家族持有企業引入大型上市旅遊集團作為控股股東。Sandals創辦人Gordon「Butch」Stewart於2021年去世後，家族資產及信託安排曾涉及爭議及法律程序，而公司股權未來如何安排，也將成為交易談判的重要環節。
目前雙方均未正式宣布交易協議，因此仍無法確認最終成交價格、持股比例、融資方式及治理架構。若談判順利完成，皇家加勒比將從郵輪市場進一步延伸至加勒比海全包式度假村市場；若協議未能達成，則上述交易條件也可能完全不會落實。
paras_en: Royal Caribbean Group (RCL-US) is close to striking a roughly $3 billion deal with Caribbean resort operator Sandals Resorts International to acquire a 50% stake. If completed, Sandals would be valued at about $6 billion, allowing Royal Caribbean to expand from cruise ships into the all‑inclusive land‑based resort market.

Sources say negotiations are ongoing, with Royal Caribbean aiming for a 50% stake while some members of the Stewart family may retain the remaining equity. Under the current structure, Royal Caribbean would become Sandals’ controlling shareholder and could later seek full ownership.

The transaction is not yet finalized and terms could change. Insiders note an agreement could be reached within days, but a breakdown remains possible, so the $3 billion price, 50% stake and $6 billion valuation are still subject to negotiation.

If the deal closes, it would be one of the largest acquisitions in Royal Caribbean’s history and would reshape its business footprint. The cruise line has been expanding beyond ships, developing private destinations and land‑based projects, and a Sandals stake would give it direct access to the Caribbean all‑inclusive resort market.

Sandals and its Beaches brand operate more than ten resorts across the Caribbean, including Jamaica, the Bahamas, St. Lucia, Grenada, Antigua, Barbados and the Turks‑and‑Caicos Islands. Reports say the two brands together run about 20 resorts, and a Royal Caribbean‑controlled Sandals would broaden its land‑based presence in the region.

For Royal Caribbean, Sandals’ all‑inclusive model complements its cruise business. Cross‑selling between ships and resorts could offer travelers land‑based accommodations after a cruise and funnel Sandals’ existing guests toward Royal Caribbean’s cruise products.

Royal Caribbean has recently shifted from a pure cruise operator to a broader vacation platform. Its Q2 2026 earnings report shows the group operates 71 vessels under its own and partner brands, serving over 1,000 destinations in more than 120 countries, and it plans roughly $4.7 billion in capital expenditures for 2026, covering new ships and land‑based investments.

The company has said it is building a wider vacation platform so travelers can choose its products in more settings. Its Q2 2026 results note strong consumer demand for vacation experiences and booking trends for 2027 that are ahead of historical levels.

Sandals has been expanding and upgrading its portfolio. In 2026 the company announced that the Beaches brand will add five resorts over the next five to six years, investing nearly $1 billion in new builds and upgrades in markets such as Jamaica, Barbados, the Bahamas and St. Vincent, while existing properties like Sandals Montego Bay and Sandals Royal Caribbean are slated for major renovations.

After the deal rumor surfaced, Royal Caribbean’s share price fell about 6%, drawing market attention to the potential transaction. Over the past year the stock has dropped roughly 25%, and the company recently revised its revenue growth outlook amid shifting European cruise demand.

Nevertheless, recent operating performance remains solid. Royal Caribbean posted Q2 2026 net income of about $1.1 billion, slightly down from roughly $1.2 billion a year earlier; six‑month net income was about $2.1 billion, up from $1.9 billion year‑over‑year. Q2 revenue rose $294 million versus the prior year, and six‑month revenue increased by $747 million.

The firm expects Q3 2026 revenue to grow about 8% year‑over‑year, with net margin roughly flat, and forecasts adjusted earnings per share between $6.26 and $6.36. As of June 30 2026, Royal Caribbean still has $805 million of authorized stock‑repurchase capacity.

For Sandals, the deal could bring a large publicly‑listed travel group in as a controlling shareholder of the family‑owned business. Founder Gordon “Butch” Stewart died in 2021, and the family’s asset and trust arrangements have been contested in legal proceedings, making the future equity structure a key negotiation point.

No formal agreement has been announced by either side, so final price, ownership percentage, financing and governance remain unconfirmed. If negotiations succeed, Royal Caribbean will extend from cruises into the Caribbean all‑inclusive resort market; if not, the proposed terms may never be realized.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】料BOJ升息緩慢，日圓備受壓力
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank Anticipates Slow BOJ Rate Hikes, Yen Under Pressure
paras: ◆USD/JPY

芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比與聖路易斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆均主張美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步升息，並據美國總統川普表示願意會見將出席紐約舉行的聯合國大會的伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚，重燃兩國重啟談判的希望，導致油價下跌，提振市場情緒，而且日本央行(BOJ)上周調升利率，但兩名委員反對加息及缺乏明確鷹派指引，市場押注BOJ難以跟上全球主要央行的鷹派步伐，讓日本與主要經濟體之間維持較大利率差距，令日圓承壓，週二適逢日本假期休市，交投清淡，推動美元兌日圓觸及157.77高點。

據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯發文稱，因未來通貨膨脹持續高於2%目標的風險上升，支持FED上周加息，里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金亦稱，美國經濟越來越強勁，通貨膨脹風險仍占上風，但上周傳言日本曾對美元兌日圓詢價，此舉被視為當局入市干預的前兆，限制日圓走貶，並據美國總統川普表示，伊朗一直與美國進行接觸，認為兩國最終將達成協議，而且油價下跌，緩解通貨膨脹擔憂，打壓美元兌日圓至156.80低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼表示，經濟復甦和通貨膨脹前景面臨風險，但澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特重申，今年可能不得不第四次加息以控制通貨膨脹，並據RBA總裁布洛克稱，鑒於能源價格居高不下且國內需求持續過度，通貨膨脹面臨的上行風險可能正在顯現，市場分別加大押注RBA與RBNZ再加息，提振澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，德國主要經濟研究機構包括WI研究所、伊福經濟研究所、IfW智庫、IWH以及DIW分別將今、明兩年經濟增長預期上調至1.3%及1.1%，帶動歐元兌美元盤整於1.1478高點。

隨後歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩表示，推高油氣價格的能源衝擊持續時間恐比ECB在3月預期的要長，地緣政治風險似乎再次升高，並據ECB指出，中國工業轉型正在將歐洲企業擠出全球市場，機械設備與運輸設備行業受影響尤為顯著，其中德國企業遭遇的衝擊最大，而且歐元區9月消費者信心指數較前月降1.0點至負16.5，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1428低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1450-70，支撐於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國數據顯示8月公共部門借款達183億英鎊高於預期，並上修2026/27財政年前四個月借款數據，累計赤字再超出官方預測，增添財政大臣希首份預算案前壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3387高點下滑。據英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布9月工業訂單差值升至負9，但伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽，推動油價下跌，減輕英國央行(BOE)升息壓力，導致英鎊兌美元跌至1.3318低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3340-60，支撐於1.3250-70。

paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Tuesday (the 22nd), continuing the boost from the Fed’s rate hike last week. The euro fell after weak consumer‑confidence data were released.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 100.54, its highest level since July 29.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously last Wednesday to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%. In addition, the Fed’s updated economic outlook summary showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sent a clear hawkish signal at the post‑decision press conference.
Higher‑rate environments generally favor a stronger dollar. Since the Fed’s hike, the dollar has gained nearly 1%.

Boston Fed President Susan Collins reiterated her support for the FOMC’s decision on Tuesday. In a social‑media post she stressed that elevated price pressures call for a more restrictive policy stance to achieve long‑term price stability.
She added that recent economic indicators suggest that after more than five years of persistently high costs, the likelihood of a scenario where “inflation is clearly above 2%” has increased.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin also backed the FOMC’s rate‑rise decision, noting that current inflation risks are higher than the risks posed by full employment.
Oil prices become a market focus

A major theme this month is central‑bank tightening driven by energy‑related price pressures, with both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening policy. Against this backdrop, recent declines in oil prices have drawn attention from FX market participants.

Benchmark crude has fallen for five consecutive trading days, driven by easing concerns over supply disruptions and hopes for progress in Middle‑East diplomacy. Traders were encouraged by Saudi Arabia’s decisive actions to offset the impact of a key pipeline closure that was damaged during the expanded conflict with Iran‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces.

U.S. President Donald Trump’s possible meeting with the Iranian delegation, including its foreign minister and president, during the United Nations General Assembly this week has also lifted market sentiment. In a speech at the UN on Tuesday, Trump said he believes an agreement between Washington and Tehran will be reached after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “What’s happening this week could be pivotal for the medium‑term direction of crude prices, because the key players in the U.S.–Iran conflict will start talks in New York today. The agreements and consensus reached in those talks could determine whether the war escalates or a path out of the conflict is found.”

He noted, “The trajectory of oil prices will continue to affect global inflation and the policy choices of central banks. We have seen every major central bank (including the Fed) cite energy prices or ‘geopolitics’ as a driver for future decisions. That is the underlying reason for the recent hawkish rhetoric.”

Wizman added, “We still link higher oil prices with a stronger dollar against major currencies. This is not because high oil prices would force the Fed to hike rates; if oil rises further, all central banks would turn hawkish. The reason is that U.S. economic growth and the dollar benefit from improved trade terms and real‑income effects from higher oil prices. We believe the U.S.–Iran conflict, by keeping crude prices elevated, has become a key factor supporting the dollar’s strength this year.”
Euro weakens, yen slips slightly
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1448. Earlier data showed Euro‑area consumer confidence for September weakened from August, ending a four‑month streak of improvement.

On the other hand, after the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week, the yen briefly accelerated its depreciation but has now paused, with little change in the exchange rate. The dollar/yen is slightly above the flat level at 157.38.

Because Japan is entering a continuous holiday period, Asian trading volumes are low. FX allocation firms warn that this seasonal lull can amplify market volatility and the impact of central‑bank actions.

The Nikkei reported that the BOJ has conducted a formal “exchange‑rate inquiry” with the FX trading desk, heightening market anxiety. The procedure involves central‑bank officials calling commercial banks to request real‑time executable rate quotes.

Although the yen has continued to weaken after the BOJ’s non‑consensus 25‑basis‑point hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31‑year high, market strategists point out that Tokyo still wields massive policy firepower. Japan holds roughly $1 trillion in foreign‑exchange reserves, providing ample liquidity to authorities.

Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.
